events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Vibe
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Wishing Liam Gallagher a very Happy 54th Birthday today. What's your favourite tune featuring that unmistakable voice?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album dropped today in '71, and its message still resonates. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Apple announced the first iPod
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Remember Your First iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple introduced the original iPod. Suddenly, 1,000 songs really could be in your pocket. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who's your ultimate 007 and what's the best Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy Endures
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Basil!
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the iconic 'White Album'. A double LP packed with diverse tracks – which one's on your repeat list?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Fifty-nine years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that changed the game. Which track from this classic stands out for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, we pause to remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we're celebrating the extraordinary life and artistry of David Bowie. What's your favourite era of the chameleon of rock?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering 'The King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Join us in celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. What's your go-to Elvis track?
